_metadata.name: Bundle B F1.7 — Bahrain-consultation bias matrix (24 queries)
_metadata.purpose: Verify the B.0 Bahrain-first source registry is consulted on every non-luxury escalating query. Each entry below is NON-LUXURY (mainstream / mid-tier / appliance / grocery), so the Tier 1.5 escalation should fire a Bahrain `site:` discovery query and — when a registry retailer has the product — yield a route:'registry' price-value trace. The runner asserts >=1 route:'registry' across the matrix and at least one per category that has a bahrain-tier registry source, and records the before/after gpt_training-priced count.
_metadata.derived_from: data/validation_gold_truth.json (Sprint A 50q corpus); .qa-bias-rerun/ was an empty transient artifact, rebuilt here.
_metadata.weighted_toward: 0%-Bahrain-hit classes (AC/appliances, grocery local, supplements) + mainstream electronics + non-luxury fragrances
